R.name: Realistic
R.summary: Realistic people think with their hands. You like seeing a result you can touch: a circuit that works, a building that stands, a crop that grows, a car that starts on the first try. You would rather fix the UPS than write an essay about it. At school you probably enjoyed practicals more than theory, and you are often the one relatives call when the inverter stops working. You value skill, competence and getting things done, and you are happiest with clear problems, tools, machines, outdoor work or physical activity.

careers.title: Civil Engineer
careers.degree: BE/BSc Civil Engineering (UET, NUST, NED, GIKI or provincial universities)
careers.entry: ECAT, NUST NET or university entry test; PEC registration after graduating
careers.outlook: Steady demand from housing, roads, dams and flood-resilient rebuilding, plus strong Gulf demand.

careers.title: Mechanical Engineer
careers.degree: BE Mechanical Engineering
careers.entry: ECAT, NUST NET, GIKI or university entry test; PEC registration
careers.outlook: Steady in manufacturing, energy and HVAC; Gulf and overseas project roles remain popular.

careers.title: Electrical / Power Engineer
careers.degree: BE Electrical Engineering (power or electronics)
careers.entry: ECAT, NUST NET, FAST or COMSATS admission test; PEC registration
careers.outlook: Growing as Pakistan expands solar, grid upgrades and battery storage.

careers.title: Mechatronics & Robotics Engineer
careers.degree: BE Mechatronics (NUST, UET, Air University and others)
careers.entry: NUST NET, ECAT or university entry test
careers.outlook: Emerging field as automation spreads in textiles, food processing and warehousing.

careers.title: Solar PV Technician / Installer
careers.degree: NAVTTC or TEVTA solar installation certificate (three to six months)
careers.entry: No degree needed: matric or intermediate, then a short course and field practice
careers.outlook: Booming: rooftop solar is one of Pakistan's fastest-growing trades in 2026.

careers.title: Electrician / HVAC Technician
careers.degree: DAE Electrical, or TEVTA/NAVTTC certificate in electrical or refrigeration and AC
careers.entry: After matric; Gulf jobs usually need a skills verification test and a licensed overseas employment promoter
careers.outlook: Constant local demand and large, steady demand across the Gulf.

careers.title: Auto & EV Technician
careers.degree: DAE Auto & Diesel or TEVTA automotive diploma
careers.entry: After matric; apprenticeship at a workshop or dealership
careers.outlook: Steady; hybrid and EV repair skills are a fast-growing niche.

careers.title: Armed Forces Officer
careers.degree: PMA Long Course, PN Academy or PAF Academy (with degree programmes)
careers.entry: Online registration, written tests, medical and ISSB
careers.outlook: Stable, respected career with regular annual intakes.

careers.title: Agriculture Scientist / Agritech Specialist
careers.degree: BSc (Hons) Agriculture (UAF Faisalabad, PMAS-AAUR, Sindh Agriculture University)
careers.entry: University entry test after FSc Pre-Medical or Pre-Engineering
careers.outlook: Growing interest in agritech, water efficiency and climate-smart farming.

careers.title: CAD Drafter / 3D Modeller (remote)
careers.degree: DAE or short courses in AutoCAD, Revit or SolidWorks
careers.entry: No university degree needed; a strong portfolio and freelance platforms
careers.outlook: Remote drafting and BIM work for foreign firms is a growing freelance niche.

careers.title: Chef / Culinary Professional
careers.degree: Culinary diploma from TEVTA or a private hospitality institute
careers.entry: After matric or intermediate; kitchen apprenticeship
careers.outlook: Restaurants, cloud kitchens, hotels and Gulf hospitality keep demand steady.

careers.title: Mobile & Electronics Repair Technician
careers.degree: NAVTTC or TEVTA mobile and electronics repair course
careers.entry: No degree needed; short course plus a shop apprenticeship
careers.outlook: Every market needs one, and skilled technicians often grow into their own shop.

R.subjects: FSc Pre-Engineering (Physics, Chemistry, Maths) for engineering; FSc Pre-Medical for agriculture; matric with science followed by DAE or a TEVTA/NAVTTC course for technical trades; A-levels Physics, Maths and Chemistry (or Further Maths).

I.name: Investigative
I.summary: Investigative people need to know why. You enjoy puzzles, patterns and questions without easy answers, and you would rather understand a problem fully than rush a quick fix. You may be the student who argues with the textbook, the cousin who fact-checks every forward in the family WhatsApp group, or the one who reads the leaflet before taking any medicine. You value logic, evidence and independence, and you are happiest when you can analyse, research, experiment and think deeply without constant interruption.
strengths: Curiosity and a love of learning

careers.title: Doctor (MBBS)
careers.degree: MBBS (five years) at a public or private medical college
careers.entry: MDCAT; then house job, with FCPS or USMLE/PLAB for specialisation
careers.outlook: Always needed; competition for seats and specialist training is intense.

careers.title: Pharmacist
careers.degree: Pharm-D (five years)
careers.entry: University entry test after FSc Pre-Medical (some universities use MDCAT scores)
careers.outlook: Steady roles in pharma companies, hospitals, quality control and regulatory affairs.

careers.title: Software Engineer
careers.degree: BS Computer Science or Software Engineering (FAST, NUST, COMSATS, ITU, LUMS and others)
careers.entry: FAST admission test, NUST NET, LUMS admission test or SAT
careers.outlook: Strong local and remote demand; AI tools are reshaping entry-level work, so projects matter.

careers.title: Data Scientist / AI Engineer
careers.degree: BS CS, Data Science, Statistics or Mathematics, plus online specialisations
careers.entry: NUST NET, FAST or LUMS for the degree; a GitHub or Kaggle portfolio for jobs
careers.outlook: One of the fastest-growing fields locally and remotely; employers want proof of real projects.

careers.title: Data Analyst (remote)
careers.degree: Any bachelor's helps, but certificates in Excel, SQL, Power BI or Python can be enough
careers.entry: Online courses (DigiSkills and global platforms) plus a portfolio; freelancing platforms
careers.outlook: High remote demand, and a practical entry point without an expensive degree.

careers.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
careers.degree: BS Cyber Security or CS (Air University, NUST, FAST and others), or industry certifications
careers.entry: University entry test, or self-study certifications such as CompTIA Security+
careers.outlook: Growing as banks, telecoms and government services digitise; strong remote options.

careers.title: Medical Lab Technologist
careers.degree: BS Medical Lab Technology, or a two-year allied health diploma
careers.entry: University test after FSc Pre-Medical; provincial medical faculty diplomas after matric
careers.outlook: Steady demand in hospitals, private labs and diagnostic chains.

careers.title: Clinical Psychologist
careers.degree: BS Psychology, then MS Clinical Psychology or ADCP
careers.entry: University entry tests; supervised clinical training and internships
careers.outlook: Rising mental-health awareness is increasing demand in cities and online.

careers.title: Economist / Policy Researcher
careers.degree: BS Economics (PIDE, LUMS, QAU, GCU and others)
careers.entry: University entry tests; CSS (FPSC) for government economic roles
careers.outlook: Needed in think tanks, banks, the State Bank and development organisations.

careers.title: Biotechnologist / Research Scientist
careers.degree: BS Biotechnology or Biochemistry, then MPhil/PhD (HEC and foreign scholarships)
careers.entry: University entry test after FSc Pre-Medical
careers.outlook: A niche locally and stronger abroad; research careers often involve study overseas.

careers.title: Environmental / Climate Scientist
careers.degree: BS Environmental Sciences, with GIS and data skills
careers.entry: University entry test after FSc
careers.outlook: Growing after recent floods: climate adaptation, NGOs and international projects.

careers.title: Forensic Scientist
careers.degree: BS Forensic Science (offered by several universities)
careers.entry: University entry test; recruitment by provincial forensic science agencies
careers.outlook: A small, specialised field linked to policing and the courts.

I.subjects: FSc Pre-Medical (Biology, Chemistry, Physics) for medicine, pharmacy and life sciences; FSc Pre-Engineering or ICS (Computer Science, Maths, Physics or Statistics) for computing and data; FA with Economics, Statistics and Psychology for social sciences; A-levels Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Maths or Computer Science.

A.name: Artistic
A.summary: Artistic people see the world as raw material for something new. You notice colour, sound, words and design, and you would rather invent your own way than follow a template. You might be the one who designs the shaadi card, edits the family trip video, writes poetry in your notes app, or rearranges the drawing room furniture just to see how it looks. You value originality, self-expression and freedom, and you are happiest when your work lets you imagine, design, write, perform or create something people can feel.
strengths: An eye for beauty, design and detail
The ability to move and connect with people

careers.title: Architecture & Building Design
careers.degree: B.Arch (five years) at NCA, UET, NED, IVS, COMSATS and others
careers.entry: NCA or university aptitude test and portfolio; PCATP registration after graduating
careers.outlook: Steady in housing and urban projects; 3D visualisation adds remote options.

careers.title: Graphic Designer (freelance)
careers.degree: BFA/BDes (NCA, IVS, PIFD), or short courses such as DigiSkills graphic design
careers.entry: Portfolio first; Fiverr, Upwork, Behance and agency work
careers.outlook: One of Pakistan's biggest freelance categories; AI tools raise the bar for quality and ideas.

careers.title: UI/UX Designer
careers.degree: BS/BDes, or certificates in Figma and UX research
careers.entry: A portfolio of app and website case studies; remote job boards and software houses
careers.outlook: Strong remote demand as more businesses build apps and digital services.

careers.title: Fashion / Textile Designer
careers.degree: BS Fashion or Textile Design (PIFD, NCA, NTU Faisalabad and others)
careers.entry: Admission test and portfolio
careers.outlook: Pakistan's textile exports and online boutiques keep design talent in demand.

careers.title: Drama & Screenwriter
careers.degree: Any degree; often BS Media Studies or English/Urdu Literature
careers.entry: Writing samples, workshops and pitching to production houses
careers.outlook: Pakistani dramas have huge audiences at home and abroad, and streaming adds new outlets.

careers.title: Content Writer / Copywriter (remote)
careers.degree: Any bachelor's or none; strong English or Urdu writing
careers.entry: Writing portfolio, freelance platforms and agency internships
careers.outlook: Steady, but AI means clients now pay for voice, strategy and editing skill.

careers.title: Video Editor / Content Creator
careers.degree: Short courses in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve; no degree required
careers.entry: Self-taught portfolio; YouTube, Instagram, agencies and freelance clients
careers.outlook: High local and remote demand for short-form video editors.

careers.title: Animator / Game Artist
careers.degree: BS Animation, Multimedia Arts or Game Design, or online courses
careers.entry: Portfolio and studio art tests
careers.outlook: Pakistan has an active mobile game industry, and remote art roles are growing.

careers.title: Wedding & Brand Photographer / Videographer
careers.degree: No degree needed; short courses and apprenticeship
careers.entry: Assist an established studio and build your own portfolio
careers.outlook: Shaadi season keeps skilled photographers booked year after year.

careers.title: Interior Designer
careers.degree: BS Interior Design, or a diploma from TEVTA or a private institute
careers.entry: Portfolio; university entry test for the degree route
careers.outlook: Growing with new housing societies and a strong renovation culture.

careers.title: Journalist / Digital Media Producer
careers.degree: BS Mass Communication or Media Studies
careers.entry: University entry test; internships in newsrooms or digital outlets
careers.outlook: Traditional newsrooms are shrinking, while digital, video and fact-checking roles grow.

careers.title: Calligrapher / Artisan Entrepreneur
careers.degree: Ustad-shagird training, NCA short courses or self-taught
careers.entry: Sell through Instagram, exhibitions and online marketplaces
careers.outlook: A niche but meaningful path; calligraphy, truck art and crafts sell well to the diaspora.

A.subjects: FA with Fine Arts, English Literature, Urdu or Psychology; ICS for digital design, animation and UI/UX; FSc Pre-Engineering (with Maths) for architecture; A-levels Art & Design, English Literature, Media Studies or Design & Technology.

S.name: Social
S.summary: Social people are energised by helping others learn, grow and feel understood. You are the friend people call at 2 am, the sibling who explains maths to younger cousins, the one who quietly checks that everyone at the dawat has been served. You notice how people feel, and you care about fairness and kindness. You value relationships, service and meaningful work, and you are happiest teaching, guiding, caring, counselling or supporting people, especially when you can see the difference you make.

careers.title: Teacher / Lecturer
careers.degree: B.Ed or ADE for school teaching; BS/MPhil in your subject for lecturing
careers.entry: FPSC, PPSC or provincial teacher recruitment tests; private school interviews
careers.outlook: Steady demand everywhere, especially for strong STEM and English teachers.

careers.title: Online Quran or Subject Tutor (remote)
careers.degree: No degree needed; Quran with tajweed certification, or subject expertise
careers.entry: Teach through online academies or independently for diaspora families
careers.outlook: Large, steady demand from families in the UK, US, Canada and the Gulf.

careers.title: Nurse
careers.degree: BS Nursing (four years) at a public or private nursing college
careers.entry: Nursing entry test after FSc Pre-Medical; registration with the national nursing council
careers.outlook: Strong local need and growing demand in the Gulf, UK and beyond.

careers.title: Physiotherapist
careers.degree: Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT, five years)
careers.entry: University entry test after FSc Pre-Medical (some use MDCAT scores)
careers.outlook: Growing in hospitals, sports clubs and home-visit services.

careers.title: Counsellor / School Psychologist
careers.degree: BS Psychology, then MS Counselling or ADCP
careers.entry: University entry tests; supervised practice
careers.outlook: Schools, universities and online platforms are increasingly hiring counsellors.

careers.title: Nutritionist / Dietitian
careers.degree: BS Human Nutrition & Dietetics
careers.entry: University entry test after FSc Pre-Medical
careers.outlook: Growing interest in healthy eating, hospital roles and online consulting.

careers.title: HR Professional
careers.degree: BBA (HR) or any bachelor's, with HR certifications later
careers.entry: University entry tests (IBA, LUMS and others); management trainee programmes
careers.outlook: Every growing company needs HR, and remote recruiting roles exist too.

careers.title: Social Worker / Development Professional
careers.degree: BS Social Work, Sociology or Development Studies
careers.entry: University entry test; internships with NGOs and UN agencies
careers.outlook: Steady in NGOs, especially in health, education and flood-recovery projects.

careers.title: Speech or Occupational Therapist
careers.degree: BS Speech & Language Pathology or BS Occupational Therapy
careers.entry: University entry test after FSc Pre-Medical
careers.outlook: A small field with unmet demand, particularly in children's services.

careers.title: Emergency Medical Technician (Rescue 1122)
careers.degree: Provincial emergency services academy training after intermediate
careers.entry: Rescue 1122 recruitment: written, physical and interview stages
careers.outlook: A respected public-service role with regular recruitment rounds.

careers.title: Customer Success Specialist (remote)
careers.degree: Any bachelor's or none; strong English and communication
careers.entry: Apply to remote-first companies and BPOs; build experience and references
careers.outlook: A large remote market; Pakistani time zones suit UK and US clients.

careers.title: Montessori / Early Childhood Educator
careers.degree: Montessori diploma (around one year) or ADE
careers.entry: After intermediate; private school interviews
careers.outlook: Steady demand in private schools, and a route to running a home-based daycare.

S.subjects: FSc Pre-Medical for nursing, physiotherapy, nutrition and therapy careers; FA with Psychology, Sociology, Education, Islamiyat or English; I.Com for HR and business routes; A-levels Psychology, Sociology, Biology or English.

E.name: Enterprising
E.summary: Enterprising people want to make things happen and bring others along. You enjoy persuading, leading, negotiating and taking calculated risks. You might be the one who started selling something at school, who bargains with every shopkeeper in the bazaar, or who ends up organising the cousins' trip because nobody else will decide. You value influence, achievement and results, and you are happiest when you can lead a team, build a business, close a deal or turn an idea into something that earns.

careers.title: Entrepreneur / Startup Founder
careers.degree: Any degree or none; BBA, CS or engineering helps
careers.entry: Build a small product, join a National Incubation Centre or university incubator, pitch investors
careers.outlook: Funding is selective, but lean, profitable startups are finding their footing.

careers.title: E-commerce Seller
careers.degree: No degree needed; DigiSkills e-commerce course or online learning
careers.entry: Start on Daraz, Instagram or your own store; scale with ads
careers.outlook: A large, growing local market, with cross-border selling slowly opening up.

careers.title: Sales / Business Development Executive
careers.degree: BBA or any bachelor's
careers.entry: Management trainee programmes and interviews; communication matters most
careers.outlook: Every company needs revenue; remote B2B sales roles for foreign firms are growing.

careers.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
careers.degree: BBA Marketing, or Google and Meta certificates and DigiSkills digital marketing
careers.entry: A portfolio of campaigns; agency internships; freelance platforms
careers.outlook: Very high local and remote demand as businesses move online.

careers.title: Lawyer
careers.degree: LLB (five years)
careers.entry: HEC Law Admission Test (LAT); after graduating, Law GAT and a Bar Council licence
careers.outlook: Competitive but steady; corporate, tax and technology law are growing niches.

careers.title: Civil Servant (PAS, PSP, Foreign Service and other groups)
careers.degree: Any bachelor's degree
careers.entry: CSS exam by FPSC
careers.outlook: Highly competitive, prestigious and stable; serious preparation is essential.

careers.title: Banker / Relationship Manager
careers.degree: BBA, BS Accounting & Finance or MBA
careers.entry: Bank management trainee (MTO) tests and interviews
careers.outlook: Steady; digital banking is shifting roles towards technology and advisory work.

careers.title: Real Estate Consultant
careers.degree: No degree needed; strong local market and documentation knowledge
careers.entry: Join an established agency and learn the trade; register where required
careers.outlook: Cyclical but always active; honesty and transparency set the best agents apart.

careers.title: Event Planner (weddings and corporate)
careers.degree: No degree required; hospitality or management courses help
careers.entry: Assist an established planner and build a vendor network
careers.outlook: Shaadi season makes this a big, year-round business in major cities.

careers.title: Product Manager (tech)
careers.degree: BS CS, BBA or engineering, plus product management courses
careers.entry: Usually through associate product manager or business analyst roles
careers.outlook: A well-paid role in local tech companies and remote startups.

careers.title: Restaurant / Food Business Owner
careers.degree: Culinary or hospitality diploma optional
careers.entry: Start with a home or cloud kitchen; provincial food authority licence
careers.outlook: Pakistanis love eating out, and delivery apps keep the sector growing.

careers.title: Import / Export Trader
careers.degree: BBA, I.Com or hands-on experience; TDAP training programmes
careers.entry: Learn customs procedures; register with FBR and a chamber of commerce
careers.outlook: Openings in textiles, rice, surgical goods, sports goods and IT services exports.

E.subjects: I.Com (Accounting, Business, Economics) for business and finance; FA with Economics, Political Science, Civics or English for law and civil service; ICS for tech product roles; A-levels Business, Economics, Law or Sociology.

C.name: Conventional
C.summary: Conventional people bring order to chaos. You like clear systems, accurate records and knowing exactly what is expected. You might be the one who keeps the family committee (BC) accounts, files every receipt, or notices when the electricity bill doesn't add up. You would rather do something right than do it fast and sloppy. You value accuracy, stability and responsibility, and you are happiest organising data, managing money, following procedures and building systems that other people can rely on without a second thought.

careers.title: Chartered Accountant (CA)
careers.degree: ICAP qualification (CAF, CFAP and articles); can begin after intermediate
careers.entry: ICAP registration and exams
careers.outlook: Consistently in demand; CAs lead finance, audit and tax across Pakistan and the Gulf.

careers.title: ACCA Professional
careers.degree: ACCA qualification, often alongside a degree
careers.entry: Register after A-levels or intermediate
careers.outlook: Globally recognised and well suited to remote finance roles or working abroad.

careers.title: Cost & Management Accountant
careers.degree: ICMA Pakistan qualification
careers.entry: ICMA registration after intermediate or a degree
careers.outlook: Steady demand in manufacturing, costing and corporate finance.

careers.title: Auditor / Tax Consultant
careers.degree: B.Com, BBA or BS Accounting & Finance, plus tax law courses
careers.entry: Train under senior consultants; FBR and professional body registration
careers.outlook: Growing as the tax net widens and more people file returns.

careers.title: Bookkeeper (remote)
careers.degree: No degree required; QuickBooks or Xero certification
careers.entry: Freelance platforms and remote accounting firms
careers.outlook: Strong remote demand from small businesses in the US, UK and Australia.

careers.title: Medical Billing & Coding Specialist (remote)
careers.degree: Short certification courses; any bachelor's helps
careers.entry: Join one of the many US medical billing companies operating in Pakistan
careers.outlook: An established, growing industry in Lahore, Karachi and Islamabad.

careers.title: Banking Operations Officer
careers.degree: B.Com, BBA or BS Accounting & Finance
careers.entry: Bank recruitment tests, often through testing agencies
careers.outlook: Steady; digital and branchless banking still need careful operations staff.

careers.title: Government Officer (Assistant / Section Officer track)
careers.degree: Any bachelor's degree
careers.entry: FPSC, PPSC or SPSC tests; CSS for senior roles
careers.outlook: Stable, respected roles; competition is high but recruitment is regular.

careers.title: Supply Chain / Logistics Coordinator
careers.degree: BBA Supply Chain or any bachelor's; professional certifications later
careers.entry: Management trainee programmes and logistics companies
careers.outlook: Growing with e-commerce, ports and regional trade routes.

careers.title: Executive Virtual Assistant (remote)
careers.degree: No degree required; strong English, Excel and Google Workspace
careers.entry: Freelance platforms and virtual assistant agencies
careers.outlook: High demand from foreign entrepreneurs; reliability is your selling point.

careers.title: Software QA Tester
careers.degree: BS CS/SE, or ISTQB certification
careers.entry: Software house internships; FAST or NUST NET for the degree route
careers.outlook: Steady demand across Pakistan's software export industry.

careers.title: Actuary / Statistician
careers.degree: BS Statistics, Actuarial Science or Mathematics
careers.entry: University entry test; actuarial exams or Pakistan Bureau of Statistics recruitment
careers.outlook: A small, well-paid niche in insurance, pensions and research.

C.subjects: I.Com (Accounting, Commerce, Economics) for CA, ACCA and banking; ICS (Computer Science, Maths, Statistics) for data and QA roles; FSc Pre-Engineering with Maths for actuarial science and statistics; A-levels Accounting, Maths, Economics or Business.

pairs_note: Your Career Compass gives you a three-letter code, like SAE or IRC, made from your three strongest interest areas in order. The first letter is your strongest pull; the second and third shape how you like to use it. An IR person loves investigating hands-on problems, like an engineer or lab scientist, while an IS person enjoys investigating people, like a psychologist or doctor. Read the careers for all three letters and look for overlaps. Letters that sit next to each other on the Holland hexagon (R-I-A-S-E-C) blend naturally; opposite letters, like A and C, suggest unusually broad interests.
